{"consolidated_memory":"HANG ON EXIT IN cli/commands/deploy.py — TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS

**OCCASION 1: Clock Skew Issue**
- Date: 2026-01-26
- Component: cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling)
- Affected: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Symptom: process finishes work but never returns (hang on exit)
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched deadline to monotonic clock
- PR: #2799, branch: fix/hang-on-exit-1
- Reproduction: deploy sample project and wait
- Test coverage: tests/cli/test_deploy.py
- Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 4.4 s to 894 ms

**OCCASION 2: Connection Pool Exhaustion**
- Date: 2026-07-02
- Component: cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling, same context as occasion 1)
- Affected: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Symptom: process finishes work but never returns (hang on exit, same as occasion 1)
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised pool ceiling and put bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #6638, branch: fix/hang-on-exit-2
- Reproduction: deploy sample project and wait
- Measured outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 7 days running"}
